## Stage 1 — PRICE (commit `00b09570`, committed green before stage 2)

- `crates/hh-budget/src/pricing.rs` —
  - `RateUnit { micro_per_token, micro_per_1k_tokens }` — the closed
    `rate_unit` sum (canonical spellings + `parse`).
  - `PricingUnit` trait + `RatedPricingTable { table, rate_unit }` —
    the carrier design AR-09 records: `PricingTable` carries
    `micro_per_token` by construction (the spec default, every
    pre-existing row keeps its meaning); a non-default unit rides
    `at_unit`. **Why a carrier and not a field:** the five
    `PricingTable`/`PricingRow` struct-literal construction sites are
    all in byte-unchanged files (hh-budget unit tests, `r5_13`,
    `golden_usage`, `account`, `r4_5d`) — stable Rust admits no new
    mandatory field; `#[non_exhaustive]`/`Option` break identically.
    The carrier annotates the unit; the rows stay the one
    representation (CC1).
  - `price` / `attribute_spend` / `Account::attribute_spend` generic
    over `T: PricingUnit` — exact per-call nano-µ$ sum in `i128`, ONE
    ceil to the µ$; roles itemize `floor` per role plus a `rounding`
    role present iff the residual is non-zero (a `micro_per_token`
    call's sum is always integral → pre-existing itemizations
    byte-identical).
  - `RateUnit::rate_from_micro_per_1m` /
    `PricingRow::from_micro_per_1m` — `NoPrice{unrepresentable_rate}`
    on a non-integral rate, never rounded (the refusal lives where an
    external denomination becomes a row — stored `i64` rates are
    always integral in-unit).
  - `ollama_glm_5_3_flash()` — the committed row: 150/30/500 µ$ per
    1k (input/cached/output), `valid_from 2026-10-22`, source citing
    experiments-spec §4.1; key `glm-5.3-flash@ollama`.
- `crates/hh-budget/tests/r6_7.rs` — AC-1 golden trial (10 007 uncached
  + 5 003 cached + 2 001 visible + 997 reasoning → exact nano-sum
  3 150 140 → ceil **3 151 µ$**; floors 1 501/150/1 000/498 +
  `rounding` 2, itemization sums exactly); AC-2 refusals
  (per-token refuses 150 000 µ$/1M as `unrepresentable_rate`;
  per-1k admits it as 150); the per-token leg proves removing
  `rate_unit` handling re-fails AC-1 (same rates price 1000×).
- `crates/hh-gateway/tests/r4_5d.rs` — the F11 comment correction
  only (`1000 micro/token ⇒ $1/1k`, was `⇒ $1/1M`); no semantics.
- `docs/adr/ADR-0425-r6.7-pricing-rate-unit.md` (AR-09) — records the
  carrier decision, the one-rounding rule, the `DeclaredPricing`
  disposition (**declared out of scope for paid studies** — it stays
  the router's dated freshness-bound reservation estimate; paid
  consumers read `PricingTable` through `PricingUnit`; no second
  representation), and the frozen `derivation.table_priced` member
  set. Index + REVISIT_TRIGGERS regenerated; BL-47 `sources` +=
  ADR-0425.

## Stage 2 — LANE (commit `a7941c38`)

- `crates/hh-gateway/src/dialects.rs` — `ollama-chat@1` and
  `ollama-messages@1` documents (clone-and-override on the family
  docs — one grammar spelling, CC1): `auth_kinds: [bearer]` on both
  (every Ollama surface Bearer-only — §4.1); `plan_schema` drops
  `tool_choice` (+`metadata` on Messages; unsupported upstream) and
  admits `reasoning_effort`/`output_config`/`budget_tokens`;
  `cache_semantics: uncached`, `cache_state_visible: false`,
  `count_tokens: none`. Responses not built (C-32).
- `crates/hh-gateway/src/http_transport.rs` —
  - `family_of` maps `ollama-messages` → `Messages`.
  - `lane_auth_header` + `auth_form_header` — the auth header derives
    from the lane's declared `auth_kinds`, not the family (the
    ADR-0366 amendment AR-11 lands). Byte-identical for every
    pre-existing dialect (anthropic → `x-api-key`; openai/compatible
    → Bearer; local lane still header-free); explicitly-requested
    undeclared forms refuse `unsupported_feature`; an explicit
    credential-form ask with an unprovided handle refuses `auth`.
  - `forward_raw(credential, endpoint_ref, op, kept_headers, body,
    auth) → RawExchange{status, headers, body, chunk_stamps[]}` —
    same `dial`/TLS/`hh-wire` codec; request bytes verbatim;
    response captured raw (JSON + SSE, any `BodyMode`); non-2xx is a
    capture, not a classified error; caller-supplied auth headers in
    `kept_headers` refuse `invalid_request`. The credential resolves
    inside the call through `header_secret` and is dropped on return.
  - `raw_frames(exchange)` — replays captured bytes through
    `SseDecoder` + family `Translator` per recorded chunk /
    `completion_frames` for JSON; equals the `send` frames path.
- `crates/hh-wire/src/http.rs` — `write_response_head_chunked` +
  `write_chunk` + `finish_chunked` (the proxy's buffered-release
  writer, design 33 §4 hint 2); `reason()` phrases for
  402/429/502/503/504.
- `crates/hh-gateway/tests/r6_7.rs` — AC-4 (fixture `TcpListener`
  sees `Authorization: Bearer` + no `x-api-key` on both lanes,
  verbatim body); AC-5 (byte-identical JSON + SSE captures;
  `raw_frames` == `send` frames over identical fixtures);
  AC-6 (`anthropic-messages`/`openai`/`openai-compatible` keep their
  auth bytes; undeclared forms + caller-supplied auth headers refuse
  typed); AC-7 (`leak_scan` clean on every returned surface —
  capture, error, record; the fixture confirms the key DID cross).
- `docs/adr/ADR-0426-r6.7-ollama-lane-raw-forward.md` (AR-11).

## Notes / ambiguity readings

- Contract Notes resolved at build time: (a) "round up per line" →
  REQ-XC-116's one-rounding rule (exact nano-sum, single ceil) —
  implemented, recorded in ADR-0425 D2; (b) AC-4.1-2's cell/receipt
  legs → DF-R6.7-1 minted, owed to R6.10 (receipt `leak_scan`,
  REQ-XC-109) and R6.16 (cell env) — the lane-level leg (AC-7) is
  landed and verified here.
- `rate_unit` as a field vs carrier — resolved as the carrier design
  (ADR-0425 D1); the literal-site constraint is load-bearing.
- `forward_raw` returns the exchange on any completed response —
  verbatim relay needs the error body's bytes; the caller (R6.10)
  classifies.
- `auth_form_header` covers `{bearer, api_key_header}`; other
  declared kinds refuse typed (none are declared today).
- The `anthropic-version` header is a kept-header the caller passes
  (§4.2 allowlist), not a dialect member — the lane test carries it.
